events.title: NFL: Falcons vs. Raiders
events.description: This is a market on predicting the outcome of the NFL game between the Atlanta Falcons and the Las Vegas Raiders.

markets.question: Will the Falcons beat the Raiders by 4 or more points?
markets.description:
This market refers to the NFL matchup between the Atlanta Falcons and the Las Vegas Raiders scheduled for December 16, 2024, at 8:30 PM ET.

This market will resolve to “Falcons” if the Atlanta Falcons win their game against the Las Vegas Raiders by 4 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to “Raiders”.

If this game is postponed after December 23, 2024 (11:59 PM ET), or canceled, this market will resolve 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

markets.question: Will the Falcons and Raiders combine for 45 or more points?
markets.description:
This market refers to the NFL matchup between the Atlanta Falcons and the Las Vegas Raiders scheduled for December 16, 2024, at 8:30 PM ET.

If the combined total points scored by the Atlanta Falcons and the Las Vegas Raiders in their game is 45 or more, this market will resolve to “Over”. If it is less than 45, this market will resolve to “Under”.

If this game is postponed after December 23, 2024 (11:59 PM ET), or canceled, this market will resolve 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

markets.question: Will Kirk Cousins throw an interception?
markets.description:
This market refers to the NFL matchup between the Atlanta Falcons and Las Vegas Raiders scheduled for December 16, 2024, at 8:30 PM ET.

If Kirk Cousins of the Atlanta Falcons throws an interception in this game, this market will resolve to "Yes". Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If this game is postponed after December 23, 2024 (11:59 PM ET) or canceled this market will resolve 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

events.title: Bill Belichick next team?
events.description: This is a market on which NFL team Bill Belichick will coach next after his tenure with the New England Patriots.

markets.question: Will Belichick head coach the Falcons in the 2024-25 NFL season?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Bill Belichick is announced as head coach for the Atlanta Falcons before any other NFL team for the 2024-25 NFL season. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If Bill Belichick is announced as head coach for any other NFL team or doesn't sign to head coach at all in the 2024-25 NFL season by the start of the first game of the regular season, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is official information from the NFL, any signing NFL team, and/or Bill Belichick and his official representative(s), however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

markets.question: Will Belichick not be head coach in the 2024-25 NFL season?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Bill Belichick is not announced as head coach for any NFL team in the 2024-25 NFL season by the start of the first game in the regular season. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If Bill Belichick is announced as head coach for any NFL team in the 2024-25 season before the start of the first game of the regular season, this market will immediately resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is official information from the NFL, any signing NFL team, and/or Bill Belichick and his official representative(s), however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

polymarket_event_sample.title: Worlds 2026 Winning Region
polymarket_event_sample.description:
This market will resolve according to the region or country of the esports team winning 1st place in the League of Legends 2026 Season World Championship (Worlds 2026).

If the winner of Worlds 2026 is not determined by December 31, 2026 ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from Fandom (https://lol.fandom.com/wiki/2026_Season_World_Championship).

Regions counted in World 2026:
- LCK (South Korea)
- LPL (China)
- LEC (Europe / EMEA)
- LCP (Asia-Pacific)
- LCS (North America)
- CBLOL (Brazil)
